Premia Is Now Kyan | Rebrand FAQs

The next chapter of Premia Labs begins now. Whether you’re a returning Premia user or not, Kyan is built for you. Trade options, perps, and multi-leg strategies seamlessly with low latency on Kyan.

Linda
August 15, 2025

As we’ve recently announced, big changes are underway at Premia Labs: Premia is now Kyan.

This rebrand is more than just a fresh coat of paint. It marks a new chapter in our mission to deliver the most advanced and flexible derivatives trading experience: tools for all traders. With portfolio margin, sub-accounts, combo trading, and CEX-like performance, Kyan takes everything we’ve learned since Premia’s inception and builds on it for the next generation of traders.

In this article, we will answer some questions you might have about how this rebrand will proceed and what will happen to Premia Blue.

Before you scroll down, sign up on kyan.blue to stay up-to-date with Kyan’s development and the upcoming beta event.

Why Is Premia Now Kyan?

As the protocol evolved, we realized that the technology we were building was more than just the next version of Premia. It was an entirely new trading system. The Kyan architecture was designed from the ground up to offer:

  • Portfolio margined options and perps

  • Low latency and zero gas fees

  • Deep liquidity for a wide range of maturities

The new name reflects that leap forward, while still carrying the DNA of what made Premia a trusted name in crypto options.

Find some Kyan UI sneak peeks below:

More on how our vision has evolved and what to expect in this article.

What Will Happen to Premia Blue (Premia V3)?

At this point in time, there are no more OLM emissions, and development on Premia Blue (Premia V3) has been halted.

While Premia Blue was a milestone for decentralized options trading, our focus is now fully on Kyan.

What About the Premia Blue Vaults?

We’re not leaving vault users behind. We plan to introduce a new passive yield strategy product within Kyan that will give users access to yield opportunities similar to vaults, but powered by the improved Kyan infrastructure.

These vaults are planned to share liquidity between Kyan and Archetype. There will be a flywheel. More details will follow after Kyan’s launch.

What About $PREMIA?

No changes here: there is only one token ($PREMIA) across all Premia Labs projects, including Kyan and Archetype.

What is Premia Labs?

Premia Labs is our new home base — a development collective that builds financial tools for traders of all backgrounds.

It’s where Kyan, Archetype, and any product carrying the .blue domain come together. And it’s how we stay true to the values that got us here, while giving each platform the freedom to do what it does best.

Read more: https://blog.premia.blue/p/introducing-premia-labs

When Will Kyan Launch?

We’re currently in a closed user feedback audit phase, gathering insights from early testers while undergoing final security checks. Parallel to that, we’re in internal QA testing, preparing for a testnet trading competition. Once those are complete, we’ll open the doors for the public beta launch.

Sign up here for updates and follow us on X.

A New Era for Premia Labs

Kyan our most advanced product yet — faster, more capital-efficient, and designed for traders who want the best of crypto derivatives trading without compromise. Whether you’re a returning Premia Blue user or not, Kyan is built for you.

Stay tuned for more updates on the trading competition, public beta, and the upcoming passive yield strategies. The future of decentralized derivatives trading starts here.

What Does Kyan Mean for Crypto Options?

Make sure you’re first in line for Kyan’s beta events and updates by singing up here.

​Kyan will be a significant upgrade for anyone trading decentralized derivatives.

If you have any questions, hop into our Discord or shoot us a message on X. We would love to know your thoughts!
